eras.title: Coral stone by the ocean
eras.caption: At Kilwa Kisiwani, coral-stone walls and vaults survive from a wealthy Swahili port. The Great Mosque and nearby palaces belonged to a town whose merchants exchanged goods across the Indian Ocean.
